integrity: The Fourier-block decomposition and the general dicyclic group determinant are prior tools; the paired parity-halving classification and complete counts are the claim under review. Finite exact-rational tests do not replace the all-parameter proof. No independent verification is claimed.
limitations: Unweighted supports of exactly three distinct elements, complex convolution rank, and cyclic-index-two dihedral/dicyclic groups only. Arbitrary weights and characteristic-dependent rank are not covered.
title: A parity-twisted three-tap nullity law for dicyclic and dihedral groups
